title: Inline Sieve delivery block in session.rs is 100 lines — extract to function
description: session.rs lines 296-397 is a single monolithic block handling Sieve per-user evaluation, reject detection, delivery, and 250/550 response. It mixes protocol response logic with storage logic. Reading the DATA handler requires tracing through 150+ lines to understand all outcomes. Suggested rewrite: extract to 'async fn sieve_delivery(...) -> SieveOutcome' returning an enum (Accepted, Rejected(String)). The DATA handler then matches the outcome and sends the SMTP response. This also makes the sieve path unit-testable without going through the full TCP session.
